name: @249.14<S88d24'53"E
detail: Distance and bearing from the last point

name: FILEDIA
detail: Open/Save dialogs gone? Set back to 1

name: PICKADD
detail: Each pick adds to the selection

name: PICKFIRST
detail: Pick objects first, then the command

name: MSLTSCALE
detail: Model tab linetypes follow annotation scale

name: CELTSCALE
detail: Object linetype scale for new objects

name: OSNAPZ
detail: Snaps use the current elevation, not the point's Z

name: FROM
detail: Offset from a base point: FROM, pick, @dx,dy

name: .XY
detail: Point filter: snap X,Y, then type the Z

name: 'Z
detail: Zoom in the middle of a command

name: Viewport scale
detail: Lock it, or a zoom ruins it

name: CHSPACE
detail: Objects are rescaled by the viewport scale

name: Turn the view
detail: PLAN zooms extents; reset the viewport scale after

name: VPMAX / VPMIN
detail: Zooming inside an unlocked viewport changes its scale

name: LAYISO / LAYUNISO
detail: Run LAYUNISO before you save or the rest stay off

name: LAYMRG
detail: The first layer is deleted; check what you picked

name: LAYDEL
detail: Deletes every object on the layer, blocks included

name: SETBYLAYER
detail: Answer N to 'blocks too' unless you mean it

name: OVERKILL
detail: Can split and rejoin polylines; select an area, not ALL

name: PEDIT Multiple
detail: Keep the fuzz small (0.01); big fuzz joins the wrong lines

name: STRETCH
detail: Crossing window right-to-left; objects fully inside move

name: FLATTEN
detail: Destroys elevations. Never on points, breaklines or 3D polylines

name: MOVE / SCALE
detail: Never on survey linework or points: coordinates are real

name: EXPLODE
detail: Never on Civil 3D points, labels, surfaces or parcels

name: BURST
detail: The block is gone; later block edits won't update it

name: BEDIT
detail: Changes every copy of that block in the drawing

name: Parcels
detail: Uncheck 'Erase existing entities' to keep the polyline

name: MAPCLEAN
detail: Save first; it edits geometry in place

name: EXPORTTOAUTOCAD
detail: Makes a separate ACAD- copy; keep working in the original

name: WBLOCK
detail: Pick Retain, not Delete from drawing

name: LTSCALE / PSLTSCALE
detail: Changes every linetype in the drawing

name: FILEDIA
detail: At 0 you get command-line prompts instead of dialogs

name: FILLET R0 - close a corner
detail: **F ↵** then **R ↵ 0 ↵** (the radius sticks until you change it) | Pick the first line on the part you want to keep | Pick the second line on the part you want to keep

name: EXTEND to a boundary
detail: **EX ↵ B ↵** (Boundary edges) | Pick the line to extend TO, then **↵** | Pick the line to extend, near the end that should grow

name: ROTATE by Reference - square a symbol to the curb
detail: **RO ↵**, pick the symbol **↵** | Base point: Insertion snap on the symbol | **R ↵** (Reference), type **0 ↵** (the symbol sits at 0 now) | **P ↵** (Points), pick two points along the curb (Nearest)

name: MLEADER - label a structure
detail: Check the leader style is SRV-20 (Annotate › Leaders) | **MLD ↵**, pick the arrow point (Insertion or Node) | Pick the landing, away from other linework | Type the label, then click outside the box

name: TEXT on a boundary line
detail: **DT ↵ J ↵ BC ↵**, pick the line's Midpoint | Height **1.6 ↵** if asked (0.08" at 1" = 20') | Rotation: pick two points along the line | Type the bearing and distance, **↵ ↵** to finish | Upside down? **TORIENT ↵**, select, **↵**

name: DIMALIGNED - a setback
detail: Make V-ANNO-DIMS-E current, style SRV-20 | **DAL ↵**, pick the house corner (Endpoint) | Second point: Shift + right-click › Perpendicular, pick the lot line | Click to place the dimension off the building

name: Viewport at 1" = 20'
detail: On the layout: **MV ↵**, pick two corners | Double-click inside the viewport | **Z ↵ 1/20XP ↵**, then pan with the wheel held down (don't zoom) | Double-click outside, select the viewport, CTRL+1, Display locked: Yes

name: PLOT to PDF
detail: On the layout tab: **CTRL+P** | Printer: DWG To PDF.pc3, paper: the sheet size | Plot area Layout, scale 1:1 | Plot style table: monochrome.ctb | Preview, then OK and name the file

name: CHSPACE - move objects between model and paper
detail: Model to paper: double-click into the viewport, **CHSPACE ↵**, select **↵** | Paper to model: on the paper, **CHSPACE ↵**, select **↵** | With several viewports, click in the one you want and **↵**

name: Turn the view to line up with a road
detail: In the viewport: **UCS ↵ OB ↵**, pick the road centerline | **PLAN ↵ ↵** (Current UCS) | **Z ↵ 1/20XP ↵** and pan back to the site; lock the viewport | Reset: **UCS ↵ ↵** (World) then **PLAN ↵ ↵**

name: PEDIT Multiple - lines into one polyline
detail: **PE ↵ M ↵**, select the lines **↵** | Convert to polylines? **Y ↵** | **J ↵** fuzz **0.01 ↵**, then **↵** to finish

name: LAYMRG - merge one layer into another
detail: **LAYMRG ↵**, pick an object on the layer to get rid of **↵** | Pick an object on the layer to keep | Read the names, then **Y ↵**

name: 'BD - line by bearing and distance (Civil 3D)
detail: **L ↵**, pick the start point | **'BD ↵**, confirm the start point | Quadrant: 1 NE, 2 SE, 3 SW, 4 NW | Bearing as DD.MMSS (**88.2453** = 88d24'53"), then the distance | **ESC** ends 'BD, **↵** ends LINE

name: Survey linework and points sit on real coordinates
detail: Survey linework and points sit on real coordinates: never MOVE, SCALE, ROTATE, FLATTEN or EXPLODE them.

name: Save (or SAVEAS a copy) before PURGE, AUDIT, OVERK
detail: Save (or SAVEAS a copy) before PURGE, AUDIT, OVERKILL, MAPCLEAN or LAYDEL.

name: Lock every viewport once its scale is set.
detail: Lock every viewport once its scale is set.

name: CTRL+Z undoes almost anything; OOPS brings back on
detail: CTRL+Z undoes almost anything; OOPS brings back only the last erase.

name: **ESC ESC** to get out of whatever comma
detail: **ESC ESC** to get out of whatever command you're in

name: Read the command line: it usually says w
detail: Read the command line: it usually says what it wants

name: Save, close and reopen. Then restart Aut
detail: Save, close and reopen. Then restart AutoCAD

name: Command line is gone
detail: **CTRL+9** (or type **COMMANDLINE ↵**). Drag it back to the bottom if it floats.

name: Ribbon is gone
detail: **RIBBON ↵**. Only tab names showing? Double-click any tab name.

name: Model and layout tabs missing
detail: Options › Display › check 'Display Layout and Model tabs'

name: Drawing tabs at the top are gone
Status bar button missing (OSNAP, LWT, coordinates)
detail: Click ≡ (Customization) at the far right of the status bar and check it

name: Workspace is a mess
detail: Gear at the bottom right › pick the workspace again. Last resort: Options › Profiles › Reset

name: Dialog boxes don't open, prompts at the command line
Crosshairs are missing (arrow instead)
detail: **CURSORTYPE ↵ 0 ↵**. Still gone: **GRAPHICSCONFIG ↵**, toggle Hardware Acceleration off and on, restart

name: Cursor jumps in steps, won't land between
Cursor only goes straight across or up
Snaps not working
detail: **F3** on; **OS ↵** to check which snaps are ticked

name: Picking a second object drops the first
Can't pick objects before the command
No grips (blue boxes) on selected objects
Selection window only works if you hold the button
Can see it but can't select it
detail: Locked layer (faded: **LAYULK ↵**), it's inside a block or xref, or you're on paper, not in the viewport

name: Wheel click shows a menu instead of panning
Right-click acts like Enter (or the reverse)
TRIM / EXTEND don't ask for cutting edges
detail: Quick mode since 2021. Type **B ↵** for boundaries, or **TRIMEXTENDMODE ↵ 0 ↵** for the old way

name: Typed point went to the wrong place
detail: Dynamic input treats typed numbers as relative. Use **#E,N** for real coordinates

name: Bearing input rejected
detail: **UN ↵**: angle type Surveyor's Units. No spaces: **@100<N45d30'00"E**

name: New objects on the wrong layer
detail: Check the current layer; **LAYMCUR ↵** and pick the right one

name: Hatch says 'boundary not closed'
detail: Find the gap, or **HPGAPTOL ↵** 0.1 to allow small gaps

name: Pasted or inserted block is 12 times too big or small
detail: Units mismatch: check **INSUNITS** in both drawings (2 = feet, 1 = inches)

name: Can't erase or move it: 'on a locked layer'
Arcs and circles look like polygons
Things vanished after a zoom, or leftovers on screen
ZOOM Extents shows a tiny drawing in a corner
detail: Stray objects far away. Window-select the empty area, erase, **Z ↵ E ↵**

name: Linetypes look solid
detail: Check **LTSCALE**; on polylines set **PLINEGEN** (Properties › Linetype generation); **RE ↵**

name: Fence or wall text upside down
Lines all look thick
detail: Lineweight display on: LWT button or **LWDISPLAY ↵ 0 ↵**

name: Hatches and wide polylines show as outlines
Fonts show as ??? or a different font
detail: Missing SHX font. Get the font, or set the text style to Arial (**ST ↵**)

name: Viewport is blank
detail: Viewport is Off (Properties › On: Yes), zoomed away, or layers VP-frozen in it

name: Scale changed when you scrolled
detail: Viewport wasn't locked: **Z ↵ 1/20XP ↵**, then lock it

name: Can't zoom inside a viewport
detail: It's locked (that's good). Unlock only to change it

name: It's on screen but won't plot
detail: Layer has plot turned off (printer icon), it's on Defpoints, or it's outside the plot area

name: Viewport border plots
detail: Put the viewport on a no-plot layer

name: Plot comes out in color or grey
Plot is tiny or cut off
detail: Plot area Layout, scale 1:1, paper size matches the sheet

name: Text or dims wrong size in the viewport
detail: Check the annotation scale on the status bar matches the viewport

name: AutoCAD crashed
detail: Reopen: the Drawing Recovery palette opens (**DRAWINGRECOVERY ↵**)

name: Need the autosave file
detail: **SAVEFILEPATH ↵** shows where; rename the .sv$ to .dwg. **SAVETIME ↵** 10 = every 10 min

name: Drawing won't open or has errors
detail: **RECOVER ↵**. Or rename the .bak next to it to .dwg

name: Opens read-only
detail: Someone has it open. Delete the .dwl/.dwl2 only if you're sure nobody does

name: Drawing is slow or huge
detail: **-PU ↵ R ↵ ↵ N ↵**, then PURGE (include Orphaned data), **AUDIT ↵ Y ↵**

name: Xrefs missing
detail: **XR ↵**, select the missing one, browse to its new path

name: Coworker can't open your file
detail: **SAVEAS** an older DWG version; for plain AutoCAD use **EXPORTTOAUTOCAD**

name: 'Proxy objects' warning
detail: Made in Civil 3D or another vertical: open it there, or ask for an EXPORTTOAUTOCAD copy

name: Points don't show
detail: Point layer frozen, point group out of date (right-click › Update), or style set to none

name: Labels show ???
detail: The label can't find its data (no elevation, deleted object)

name: 'BD won't start
detail: It only works when a command is asking for a point

name: Labels the wrong size
detail: Annotation scale (status bar) must match the plot scale

name: Drawing suddenly tilted in 3D
detail: Shift + wheel-drag orbits the view. **PLAN ↵ ↵**, or click Top on the ViewCube

name: A command does something different than it should
detail: Someone redefined it: **REDEFINE ↵** and the command name

name: Typing a command picks the wrong one
detail: Autocomplete: **INPUTSEARCHOPTIONS ↵**, or type the full name

name: Dimension shows the wrong number
detail: Text overridden (Properties › Text override: clear it) or **DIMLFAC** not 1

name: Area in LIST is wrong or missing
detail: Polyline isn't closed: Properties › Closed: Yes (check the gap first)

name: Layer won't delete or purge
detail: It's current, it's 0 or Defpoints, or a block or xref uses it: **LAYDEL ↵**

name: Pasted objects land far off the site
detail: Paste used a base point: **PASTEORIG ↵** instead

name: UCS icon somewhere odd, coordinates don't match
